question: The radius of a sphere is 21 cm. It is cut into two equal halves by a plane passing through its centre. What is 75% of the curved surface area (in cm², rounded off to the nearest tens) of the hemisphere? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a sphere is 21 cm

It is cut into two equal halves by a plane passing through its center

**Formula Used:**

CSA of the hemisphere = 2pi r²

Calculations:

When a sphere is cut from its center, we will get a hemisphere, 

CSA of the hemisphere = 2pi r²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58a190b99cba29baff5a3d19220cd2d093448434312e7fad924e078ada65ad28.png] 

CSA of the hemisphere = 2pi r²=2times (22)/(7) times 21×21 = 2772 cm²

now, 75% of the CSA of hemisphere

= 2772 times (75)/(100)=2772 times(3)/(4) = 2079 cm² 

Roundoff to the nearest tens = 2080 cm2 

**Hence, 75% of the curved surface area of the hemisphere is 2080 cm²**
